intro: Bartleby the Drunk is an early rite of passage for Alliance warriors training in Stormwind City. Directed by Harry Burlguard inside the Pig and Whistle Tavern, an aspiring fighter must confront a stubborn barfly and take his prized drinking mug. It serves as a simple test of grit, proving a warrior can handle a brawl before advancing to true martial techniques.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yeah, I can teach you. But first I wanna see what moves you have already.
See that drunk over there at the end of the bar? Bartleby? I want you to get his mug.
Hah, and if you know Bartleby then you know he won't just give it to you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello, fancy kid! What's a prissy thing like you doing in the Pig and Whistle? Be careful, or you might break a nail...
